limitations: This is a design-stage candidate-size registry, not a replacement for licensed/current standards.
Plastic IDs are derived from nominal OD and the listed minimum/nominal wall thickness; verify actual manufacturer dimensions before final construction issue.
The imperial values for ISO metric systems are conversions for user display/calculation convenience; the governing size designation remains metric.
Ductile iron, stainless steel, CPVC and specialty systems are not dimension-populated in this version.
